name: aiGetMetadata
description: Returns information about a configured AI endpoint, such as its settings and, optionally, its models and files.

params.name: name
params.description: The endpoint name from the Lucee Administrator, a `default:category` reference, or an AI session.

params.name: detailed
params.description: When true, also returns the available models and, for engines that support files, the uploaded files.

lucee.notes: Lucee 6.2 has this as `luceeAIGetMetadata()`, which Lucee 7 still supports.
